subject: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>
To: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@globexretail.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globexretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.in>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.in>
Date: 2026-07-14T19:05:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals - next steps

Thanks for the time today - great discussion. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side: 

- Objective: validate model fit for customer support summarization and routing across EU and APAC locales (FR, DE, NL, JA, KO).
- Success metrics: intent accuracy >= 92% per-locale, summary ROUGE-L delta < 0.04 vs baseline, acceptable latency P95 under 350ms for recommended configs.

Recommended initial models to benchmark (tradeoff notes included):
- Redwood-13B-instruct-q4f16 - good cost/quality balance, strong multilingual quality in EU languages.
- Llama-2-Chat-13B (finetuned prompts) - lower cost; may need prompt engineering for JA/KO.
- Mistral-Instruct-7B - fast inference, lower memory footprint for Dedicated pools.

Quick asks for next week:
1) Share sample prompt set + ~500 representative in-language examples per locale (can be redacted)
2) Confirm whether eval traffic must remain within EU residency (GDPR / data residency)
3) Access to a small test endpoint or SSO for our eval infra (read-only)

I attached a draft eval plan and an example prompt set to speed things up. Proposed timelines: 2-week pilot (benchmarks + qualitative review) starting once we have samples and test access.

Attachments: multilingual_eval_plan_v1.xlsx, prompt_set_v1.csv

Thanks - I'll loop Neha and Rishi on the technical plan.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.in

From: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@globexretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.in>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globexretail.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.in>
Date: 2026-07-14T20:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals - next steps

Thanks Marissa - this looks good and matches our needs. A couple quick clarifications: 

- EU data residency: for the pilot we need all test data and eval logs to remain in our EU project; can Redwood run the evals in eu-central (Frankfurt) region?
- Timeline: aiming to have initial pilot results in ~2 weeks; can you confirm start-of-run earliest this coming Monday (2026-07-20)?

I'll coordinate internal samples. Also looping in Rajiv to confirm SSO/service account we should provide.

Best,
Elena
Director, Customer Experience | Globex Retail
elena.petrova@globexretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>
To: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@globexretail.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globexretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.in>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.in>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.in>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals - next steps

Great - yes we can run the evaluation in eu-central (Frankfurt) to satisfy residency for the pilot. Confirming proposed plan and links below: 

Plan summary (attached): multilingual_eval_plan_v1.xlsx
- 2-week pilot: automated benchmarks (accuracy, latency, cost) + qualitative review sessions with CE team at week 1 and week 2.
- Per-locale test splits and evaluation scripts included in the Drive folder.

Recommended configs: 
- Redwood-13B-instruct-q4f16: batch size 32, temperature 0.0 for deterministic classification tasks, top_p 0.9 for summaries.
- Llama-2-Chat-13B: temperature 0.2 for summaries, deterministic for routing.
- Mistral-Instruct-7B: temp 0.0 for classification, test at higher throughput config for cost baseline.

Resource links: 
- Shared Drive (eval scripts + sample prompts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cdefg
- Redwood multilingual benchmarks summary: https://redwood.in/benchmarks/2026/multilingual
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/GBX-5421

Attachments included: multilingual_eval_plan_v1.xlsx, prompt_set_v1.csv, redwood-benchmarks-2026.pdf

Next steps from Globex: share sample prompts (per-locale), create a test service account/SSO with read-only access to their staging queue, and confirm a kickoff window (we can start as soon as Mon 2026-07-20).

If that all looks good I'll scope the initial run and send a calendar invite for the week-1 review.

- Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.in

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.in>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>, Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@globexretail.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globexretail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.in>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.in>
Date: 2026-07-15T11:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals - next steps

Thanks all - quick technical notes from the eval team: 

- Sampling and prompt details: for classification/routing runs we recommend temperature=0.0, top_p disabled; for summaries run both deterministic (temp=0.0) and stochastic (temp=0.2) to compare ROUGE and human preference.
- Tokenization/language handling: please include test examples with diacritics and multi-sentence user history for FR/DE/NL. For JA/KO provide both informal/formal variants if possible.
- Prompt templates: attached prompt_set_v1.csv contains templated prompts per-locale - please review and add any customer-specific phrases.

We will instrument per-request metadata (locale, source, conversation_length) in the eval logs so we can slice quality regressions quickly. Vivek will own model-config runs and will surface any per-locale regression flags.

- Neha
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.in
Attachment: prompt_set_v1.csv (CSV)
